page.content:
The Texas Rattlesnake who defined the Attitude Era.

How Stone Cold Steve Austin connects

  • Concept: Attitude Era — Stone Cold's antihero act defined the Attitude Era.
  • Character: Vince McMahon — Stone Cold's weekly war with boss Vince McMahon drove Attitude Era television.
  • Character: The Rock — Austin and The Rock's rivalry capped the Attitude Era at WrestleMania.

What is Stone Cold Steve Austin?

Stone Cold Steve Austin became WWE's late-1990s antihero: Austin 3:16, the beer-can boss fights with Vince McMahon, and WrestleMania title peaks against The Rock and Shawn Michaels.

Key threads lead to Attitude Era, Vince McMahon and The Rock.
